index.title: Respite: Detecting Recording-Station Failures in Robot Training Data
index.description: A frozen benchmark of station-fault detection for robot training data: Respite's rules, a robust statistical baseline and a trained model on an unseen recorder, with HFlow compared on the same files.

benchmark.title: Benchmark | Respite research
benchmark.description: Detection, alert rates, delay, diagnosis and attribution on an external XDOF test set with synthetic station faults, with 95% intervals.

demo.description: Replay stored benchmark records: twenty real episodes from one recording stream, healthy or with a synthetic fault, and what each detector said.
